title: Try an idea on a branch
summary: A branch is a movable name pointing to a line of commits. It lets you work on a change without immediately adding it to another branch.
introduction: A branch is a movable name pointing to a line of commits. It lets you work on a change without immediately adding it to another branch. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain try an idea on a branch
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A branch is a movable name pointing to a line of commits. It lets you work on a change without immediately adding it to another branch.

blocks.title: Try an idea on a branch

blocks.text: Git creates and switches to club-note. Start from a clean working tree so unrelated edits do not confuse the exercise.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Run git branch to see which branch has a star.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A new branch is not a separate full copy of all files on disk.
For more detail later, use this [Git further reading](https://git-scm.com/docs/gittutorial).
